presets.name: Thandiwe

presets.outfit: Oversized graphic tee, baggy denim jeans, scuffed high-top sneakers, beaded bracelet

presets.look: Small stature, braided hair with red clay beads, wide curious eyes, traditional beads around neck

presets.look: Clean cut, glasses, backpack, laptop, neat appearance, always reading

presets.look: Lean, bare feet, dirt on knees, wide smile, carrying a stick, wearing a cap
